name: Associate Lead (cookie)
summary: Attaches a Munchkin tracking cookie (_mkto_trk) to a known lead, so prior anonymous web activity links to that person.
whenToUse: When a lead was created without their browsing history and you have their mkt_tok/cookie value (e.g. from a landing page URL or email click).

path.name: id
path.label: Lead ID
path.hint: The known lead to attach the cookie to.

query.name: cookie
query.label: Cookie value
query.hint: The _mkto_trk cookie, in the form id:…&token:_mch-… (URL-encode the & and : if your browser mangles them).

notes: If the cookie is already attached to another known lead, new activity goes to this lead but old activity stays with the other one.
Tip: Marketo's own Push Lead call (above) can do this for you via the mktToken field.
